title: I Overhauled the visuals of Orbital Empire for a more detailed, realistic design (Thank you Opus 5.5). My discord is torn on it. What do you guys think? Does it look better than the more cartoony style?
author: everybodytrustslorne
selftext:
I've been working on upgrading the graphics from the placeholders I posted before, and I'm pretty impressed with how it turned out.

This is Orbital Empire, a correspondence 4x game, where players colonize the solar system in real time, fighting or trading for resources. Disputes and politicts play out in the game Senate, where players can propose and vote on bills to adjust the rules in uniform or targeted ways. Massive fleet battles play out over hours, movements across the solar system can take a day or more, and the game unfolds over weeks of alliances and betrayals.

Available in Beta online, with an android app looking for testers (alongside a watch companion app!)

[https://orbital-empire.com/](https://orbital-empire.com/)
